boundlesshq.com verified; Dublin-based Employer of Record platform founded 2019 by Dee Coakley, Emily Castles and Eamon Leonard. €2.5M seed (Jun 2021) co-led by Ada Ventures and FYRFLY, €3.6M raised to date at that point. Irish Times (Jan 2026) says it raised 'more than €6 million' in total (backers incl. Ada Ventures, Seedcamp); the later ~€2.4M is not itemized publicly (amount_raised is that 'more than €6M' figure). Acquired by Payoneer (announced 20 Jan 2026); Irish Times reported ~$13M purchase price per Payoneer filings.
